# PpdsDbProviderFactory

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Provider.PpdsDbProviderFactory`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

ADO.NET provider factory for creating PPDS query engine data access objects. Register with System.Data.Common.DbProviderFactories.RegisterFactory(System.String,System.Data.Common.DbProviderFactory) to enable discovery by tools like Entity Framework and Dapper.
